test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Shilpa goes to a park every day for walking. One morning, she started walking from her home and walked 40 km towards the north. Then she turned to the right and walked 60 km. Again, she turned right and walked 40 km. Lastly, she took a left turn and walked 30 km. How far is she from her home?
solution:
Given: Shilpa goes to a park every day for walking.

One morning, she started walking from her home and walked 40 km towards the north.

Then she turned to the right and walked 60 km.

Again, she turned right and walked 40 km.

Lastly, she took a left turn and walked 30 km. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7274b68dcde2551a7bdda6ad2be990283da640ae303fe17332f1f84ab36e40d.png] 

 

Now, She is 90 km far from her home.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
